orbeline.desc1: Orbeline centralizes the commercial operations of Mexican companies into a single system: electronic billing, quotations, payments, and digital policies. The unified dashboard provides immediate visibility into the financial state of the business without jumping between tools.
orbeline.desc2: I developed the backend with Laravel and the interface with React and TypeScript, integrating CFDI validation and real-time PDF generation. The system handles multiple clients with differentiated roles and permissions, deployed on AWS with Docker containers.
orbeline.d1Body: Each salesperson accesses their own dashboard with monthly closing metrics — issued, collected, and pending premiums — without relying on manual reports. Immediate visibility into their financial status allows them to make decisions before the month ends.
orbeline.d2Body: Administrators can compare closing performance between salespeople using historical and trend data, facilitating evidence-based bonus and incentive assignments rather than perception-based ones.
orbeline.d3Body: The interface follows the natural order of operations: quote → onboard client → issue policy → collect → electronic billing → commission cut and distribution. Each step advances to the next without switching tools, reducing data entry errors and idle time.
orbeline.d4Title: Codified business rules for agile quoting
orbeline.d4Body: The rules for quoting — age ranges, available coverages per product, surcharges and discounts — were scattered across the experience of senior salespeople. Encoding them in the platform shortened onboarding for new salespeople, eliminated calculation errors, and standardized commercial proposals.
orbeline.d5Body: Each policy is generated in PDF with the insurer and broker's logo and colors, eliminating manual design and layout work. Issuance goes from minutes to seconds and maintains visual consistency across all documents.

orbeline.altInvoice: Invoice viewer with line item detail

zihua.pageTitle: Landing page for land sales in Zihuatanejo
zihua.desc1: Zihua Investments is a landing page designed to present and market land in Zihuatanejo, Guerrero. The site guides interested clients through a structured land selection flow, from catalog exploration to direct contact with the sales team.
zihua.desc2: I developed the site with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, prioritizing a clean visual experience and fast loading. The land selection flow reduces friction for the client and captures qualified leads directly.
zihua.d1Body: Instead of showing a generic catalog, the site takes visitors through a step-by-step flow that filters land based on their preferences — size, location, and budget — reducing uncertainty and increasing contact rates.
zihua.d2Body: The land is presented with a high-quality image gallery in an interactive carousel, highlighting the views and characteristics of Zihuatanejo's natural environment to emotionally connect with the potential buyer.
zihua.d3Title: Development metrics as a sales argument
zihua.d3Body: A section of key indicators — number of available lots, hectares, amenities, and estimated appreciation — converts project data into concrete arguments for the buyer, building trust before the first contact.
zihua.d4Body: The video section offers an aerial view of the development, situating the visitor in the coastal environment and reinforcing the value proposition without needing additional text.
